scenario.clock: one fixed 1/60 s update per rAF; queue completion and timestamp readback awaited
scenario.timing: cpuMs is encoding/submission wall time. completionMs is encoding through queue completion wall latency including wait/browser/driver overhead. gpuMs sums measured GPU pass timestamp durations when available; null means unavailable or no complete capture. rafMs includes serialized readback overhead and is observed cadence, not pure GPU execution.
scenario.quality: fixed; no adaptive resolution or step scaling; timeScale 1
scenario.memory: logical GPU allocation sizes, not driver VRAM
scenario.runner: same window.hologpu.runBenchmark implementation as the Profiler drawer
